Our service

Innovative Digital Marketing Solutions for Sustainable Business Growth

We deliver data-driven digital marketing and ecommerce strategies that increase visibility, generate quality leads, and drive long-term business growth. From SEO and paid advertising to ecommerce development and branding, we help businesses scale with measurable, sustainable results.

01

Website & Ecommerce Development

We design and develop fast, responsive, conversion-optimised websites and ecommerce stores built on Shopify, WooCommerce, and WordPress. Whether you’re selling 10 products or 10,000, every store we build prioritises user experience, mobile performance, and seamless checkout flows.

02

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

Our SEO strategies deliver lasting organic growth for both service businesses and ecommerce stores. We conduct in-depth keyword research, technical audits, on-page optimisation, and authoritative link building to improve your rankings and increase qualified traffic.

03

Paid Media & Ecommerce Advertising

We manage high-ROI paid advertising campaigns across Google Shopping, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and more. From ecommerce product ads and dynamic retargeting to lead generation, we use precise audience targeting and continuous optimisation.

04

Digital PR & Content

We craft strategic content and digital PR campaigns that build brand authority and earn high-quality backlinks. From ecommerce buying guides and product content to press outreach and thought leadership, we tell your brand story in a way that ranks, resonates, and converts.

Work process

Results-Focused Digital Marketing & Ecommerce Agency Powered by Artificial Intelligence

We are a performance-driven digital marketing and ecommerce agency that combines artificial intelligence with data-led strategies to deliver measurable business growth. By leveraging AI-driven insights, automation, and advanced analytics, we create targeted campaigns and ecommerce experiences that increase visibility, generate qualified leads, and maximise ROI.

Research & Planning

We start by understanding your business, ecommerce goals, competitors, and target audience. Through data analysis and market research, we identify the highest-impact opportunities and build a strategy tailored to your growth objectives.

Concept & Design

Our creative team develops compelling concepts — from ecommerce store wireframes and product page layouts to ad creative and brand assets — visually striking and strategically aligned with your conversion objectives.

Testing & Quality

Before anything goes live, we rigorously test for performance, accuracy, and user experience. For ecommerce builds, we test every step of the purchase journey. We A/B test campaigns and designs to ensure every element is optimised for results.

Help & Support

Once live, we don’t disappear. Our team provides ongoing monitoring, reporting, and support — continuously refining your ecommerce store and campaigns to keep your business ahead of the competition.

FAQ

Got Questions? We’ve Got Answers

What services does your agency provide?

Prism Works Studio offers a full suite of digital marketing and ecommerce services including ecommerce website design and development, SEO, paid media management (PPC and Google Shopping), digital PR, content marketing, and brand strategy. Whether you need a single service or a fully integrated ecommerce growth strategy, we tailor our approach to your goals.

Can I update the website content myself?

Yes. We build ecommerce stores and websites on user-friendly platforms like Shopify and WooCommerce, giving you full control to manage products, update content, and run promotions without any coding knowledge. We also provide training so you’re confident managing your store from day one.

How does the web design process work?

Our process begins with a discovery call to understand your brand, ecommerce goals, and audience. From there, we move through research, wireframing, design, development, and testing — keeping you involved at every stage. Most ecommerce projects are completed within 5–8 weeks depending on scope.

How long will my project take to complete?

A standard website typically takes 3–5 weeks, while ecommerce builds range from 5–12 weeks depending on catalogue size and custom functionality. SEO and paid media campaigns typically begin showing meaningful results within 3–6 months of launch.

Do you offer website maintenance and support?

Absolutely. We offer ongoing maintenance packages for both websites and ecommerce stores, covering platform updates, security monitoring, performance optimisation, and priority support. We keep your store fast, secure, and converting.

Can you redesign my existing website or ecommerce store?

Yes — ecommerce redesigns are one of our specialities. We audit your existing store for performance, UX, conversion rate, and SEO issues, then build a new version that significantly improves speed, design, and sales performance.
